simple.meaning: שָׁתַת (shâthath) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to place , i.e. array ; reflex. to lie.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 49:15. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁתַת (H8371) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁתַת (shâthath) / H8371 is traced through Psalms 49:15, Psalms 73:9 with source-language evidence and verse context.
